text:
Tom was a ten-year-old boy. One afternoon, he was walking home from school. He saw something brown on the road. It was a wallet.

He opened it. Inside, there was a lot of money and a card with a name and address: Mr. Brown, 12 Green Street.

Tom thought, “I could buy a new bicycle with this money. Nobody is looking at me.” He put the wallet in his bag and walked a few steps.

But then he stopped. He thought about the owner. “Maybe he needs this money for his family,” he thought. “I would be sad if I lost my money.”

Tom turned around. He walked to Green Street and knocked on the door of number 12.

An old man opened the door. “Is this your wallet?” asked Tom.

The old man’s eyes became wide. “Yes! I looked for it all day. It has my medicine money. Thank you so much!”

He gave Tom a little reward, but Tom said, “No, thank you. I only wanted to help.”

That night, Tom slept very well. He felt proud of himself.

Moral: Doing the right thing makes you feel good.

quiz.q: Tom took the reward from Mr. Brown.
What was inside the wallet besides money?
o: A card with a name and address

quiz.q: What did Tom first want to buy with the money?
Doing the right ___ makes you feel good.
